patterns.note: Content sections below the hero utilize a flexible grid layout for articles and project showcases, often featuring large, impactful imagery.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established with a large, elegant serif font for primary hero navigation/headings, contrasting with a clean sans-serif for body text, subheadings, and general UI elements.

The site employs a sophisticated neutral palette of white, various shades of gray, and black for text and backgrounds, accented by a distinct red for the brand logo and a subtle blue for interactive elements.

The hero section features a background image that subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls, while the main navigation elements transition from an overlay on the hero to a sticky, solid-background header once the hero scrolls out of view.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, each introduced by a clear, uppercase heading and often accompanied by a 'See All' link, reinforcing a structured, editorial feel.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a large background image that subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls, creating depth. The main navigation elements initially overlay this hero, then transition into a fixed, solid-background sticky header once the hero section has scrolled past.

Content sections and individual cards within grids are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, typically a fade-in or subtle slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye. This likely leverages detected technologies like locomotive-scroll or scrollmagic for precise control.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif hero text (~4-5x body) with clear sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) and readable body text, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate for most elements and images, with very subtle rounding on some interactive elements or card edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, providing ample white space. Content grids maintain a consistent, slightly denser rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, elegant serif font for its primary navigation within the hero section, combined with a subtle parallax background and a sophisticated sticky header transformation, immediately sets a tone of high-end design and authority. This approach elevates the navigation from a mere functional element to a key aesthetic feature, making the initial impression memorable.
